sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by immunostaining in mouse striatum (knock-in mice, PMC8440528) and by anti-HA detection in SH-SY5Y cells (PMC8893010). Agonist-induced endocytosis of FLAG-tagged MOR observed (PMC10154970), indicating receptor remains functional. No explicit pharmacological binding or G-protein coupling assay reported in the cited clips for the HA-MOP construct specifically.
sites.rationale: OPRM1 has no signal peptide (UniProt P35372; residue 1 = Met, extracellular span 1-69 per topology landmarks). 'Amino-terminus' of a signal-peptide-free GPCR designates exactly one extracellular junction: before residue 1 (insert_after_residue=0). Python confirms seq[0]='M'. The position is topology-derived because no specific residue number is named in the papers, but the topology leaves only one possible extracellular N-terminal junction. Multiple independent studies (knock-in mouse, CRISPR knock-in in SH-SY5Y, SNAP-tag, FLAG-tag) all confirm this N-terminal extracellular position is tolerated. HA-MOP knock-in mouse model (PMC8440528): full-length mouse MOP with HA-epitope tag (YPYDVPDYA) fused to the amino-terminus, expressed from the endogenous locus. Confirmed by western blot with anti-HA (N-terminal) and UMB-3 (C-terminal) antibodies, and by immunostaining in striatum of knock-in mice. Independently replicated by CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in of HA at the amino-terminus of endogenous MOP in SH-SY5Y cells (PMC8893010). SNAP-tag placed at the same N-terminal extracellular position in SSF-MOR constructs (PMC13523046). FLAG-tagged MOR (SSF-MOR) confirmed at cell surface by M1 anti-FLAG antibody (PMC10154970).

sources.claim: We generated a novel transgenic mouse model by fusing the HA-epitope tag sequence YPYDVPDYA to the amino-terminus of MOP (HA-MOP) (Fig. 1a and Supplementary Fig. 1 ).

literature_notes: All ledger lines (L1-L6, L8-L10) converge on the same N-terminal extracellular junction (insert_after_residue=0). No ledger line grounds an insertion in ECL1 (129-143), ECL2 (209-232), or ECL3 (305-317), so no internal sites are proposed. L7 reports a C-terminally HA-tagged MOP (MOP-HA), but the C-terminus of OPRM1 is intracellular (residues 342-400 per topology landmarks), so this is recorded in other_positions as an intracellular tag. L8 (SNAP-tag) and L9 (FLAG-tag) both confirm the N-terminal extracellular position and are folded into the single terminal_n site rather than listed separately, as they pin the same junction. Validation_level is surface_only because the HA-MOP clips confirm surface expression (immunostaining) but do not report a pharmacological functional assay; L9 shows agonist-induced endocytosis of FLAG-MOR but this is attributed to the FMOR construct rather than specifically testing the tag's impact on receptor function.

literature_other_positions.note: MOP-HA (C-terminally HA-tagged full-length receptor) used in stably transfected HEK293 cells; the C-terminus of OPRM1 (residues 342-400) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
